_readme: One entry per /advertise/ price card. All amounts are founding prices, locked for 6 months (first 10 sponsors). Units spelled out so $59 never looks worse than $19. Empty url = Book now scrolls to the inquiry form.

slots.name: Newsletter sponsor
slots.desc: About 50 words and one link in one SkillMaxx Weekly issue, labeled "Sponsor". One sponsor per issue.

slots.name: Featured slot
slots.desc: The one Sponsored card in the homepage Featured row, plus a top-of-category placement, clearly labeled. Month-to-month (no long lock). BFCM: $19 for December (normally $29), one slot — code BFCM-FEATURED-DEC.

slots.name: Category sponsor
slots.desc: Your logo on one category page. One sponsor per category.

slots.name: Founding bundle
slots.desc: 1 newsletter issue + Featured + Category for one month, plus a "Founding Sponsor" credit on this page. Bought separately those three cost $63 — the bundle saves $14.
slots.subBookLabel: $42/mo for the same mix (worth $63 a la carte)

compareNote: Quick check: 1 newsletter ($19) + Featured ($29) + Category ($15) = $63. The Founding bundle is $49 for that same month ($42/mo if you subscribe). The $59/mo newsletter option is 4 issues, not 1 — about $15 each, $17 less than buying four $19 issues.
bfcmNote: Nov 27–30 ET: Category/Newsletter → 12-month founding lock. Featured December → $19 (code BFCM-FEATURED-DEC), 1 slot FCFS. Free Dec line not offered.
